scientific_integrity: Closed forms and universal inequalities have a self-contained analytic proof; independent quadrature and simulations only corroborate. Underlying classical kinematic plane measure and earlier circle-radius laws are not claimed as new.
scientific_limitations: Three-dimensional Euclidean unit sphere, an axial latitude zone and the affine-kinematic random-plane measure conditional on meeting the unit ball; no higher-dimensional or alternative-measure conclusion. Historical priority provisional, with Coleman (1989) full text inaccessible.
title: Exact Crofton component law and sharp centering for spherical latitude zones
